title: Move pkg/scheduler to staging

labels.name: sig/scheduling
labels.description: Categorizes an issue or PR as relevant to SIG Scheduling.

labels.name: triage/accepted
labels.description: Indicates an issue or PR is ready to be actively worked on.

body:
To make sure that simulation library do not need to import all kubernetes/kubernetes repository we need to move scheduler code to staging. To do so we need to make it in steps. First we need to get rid of all dependencies we have inside pkg/scheduler to k/k. To make sure that we are not adding new dependencies we should start by adding import constrains, with allowlisting already existing dependencies. When code will be free of them, we will be able to move code - either in one big PR or in couple smaller once

Phase 1 remove dependencies to kubernetes/kubernetes:

1. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141403
2. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141405
3. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141406
4. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141407
5. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141408
6. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141410
7. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141495
8. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141497
9. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141498

For ktesting imports we need to wait for sig-test to decide if they are going to move it to staging. [slack conversation](https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/C09QZ4DQB/p1786026873959519)

Phase 2 - move pkg/scheduler to staging/kube scheduler

1. Option 1. Move everything at once 
    1. We would need to hold all other PRs to scheduler for couple days or face a lot of rebasing
2. Option 2. Move piece by piece 
    1. We need to take into consideration dependencies inside pkg/scheduler
        1. There are some non trivial dependencies between framework, backend, framework test, backend test.
        1. We can move code first then unit tests - but it increases complexity and it would be hard for other PRs

/sig scheduling
